notes: Per-agent NEW-sample targets for data/training_v2 (built with --index). Among new samples, >= cu_gut_microbiome_nanocluster_min_fraction must come from the quota pool. quota_pool='cu_gut_nanomaterial' (relaxed 2026-07-25): is_cu AND gut_microbiome AND modality=nanomaterial — the strict 'cu_gut_nanocluster' keyword pool is EMPTY in the real literature (cross-domain papers use nanozymes/nanocomposites: CuL NCs, CuPt, Cu-Mn3O4, ZnO-Cu/Mn), so the relaxed definition keeps the quota honest with 8 real OA papers from 智能体建库文献/11 补充-Cu菌群交叉. If an agent's eligible pool is too small, total samples are capped so the fraction still holds; shortfalls are reported, never backfilled with fabricated data. bsa/ca/mma are the thinnest existing sets (50/50/95) and get priority.
